title.raw: 卷六十五 表第五 方鎮二 Volume 65 Tables 5: Military Commanderies 2

sentences.zh: 西元 滑衛 河南 鄭陳 淮南西道 徐海沂密 青密 北都

translations.literal: Western calendar [CE]. Hua-Wei. Henan. Zheng-Chen. Huainan West Circuit. Xu-Hai-Yi-Mi. Qing-Mi. Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: CE dates. Columns: Hua–Wei; Henan; Zheng–Chen; Huainan West Circuit; Xu–Hai–Yi–Mi; Qing–Mi; Northern Capital.

translations.literal: 710, first year of the Jingyun era.
translations.idiomatic: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign.

sentences.zh: 711 二年 北都長史領持節和戎、大武等諸軍州節度使。

translations.literal: 711, second year. The Northern Capital chief administrator concurrently held the military commissioner with full credentials over Hewu, Dawu, and the various armies and prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In 711, the second year of Jingyun, the chief administrator of the Northern Capital was also appointed military commissioner with full credentials over Hewu, Dawu, and the other armies and prefectures.

translations.literal: 712, first year of the Xiantian era.
translations.idiomatic: 712 CE, first year of the Xiantian reign.

translations.idiomatic: 716 CE, fourth year.

sentences.zh: 717 五年 領天兵軍大使。

translations.literal: 717, fifth year. He also held the post of grand envoy of the Tianbing Army.
translations.idiomatic: In 717, the fifth year of Kaiyuan, he also took command as grand envoy of the Tianbing Army.

translations.literal: 718, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 718 CE, sixth year.

translations.literal: 719, seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 719 CE, seventh year.

sentences.zh: 720 八年 更天兵軍大使為天兵軍節度使。

translations.literal: 720, eighth year. The Tianbing Army grand envoy was redesignated the Tianbing Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 720, the eighth year of Kaiyuan, the Tianbing Army grand envoy was redesignated the Tianbing Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: 721, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 721 CE, ninth year.

translations.literal: 722, tenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 722 CE, tenth year.

sentences.zh: 723 十一年 更天兵軍節度為太原府以北諸軍州節度、河東道支度營田使兼北都留守，領太原及遼、石、嵐、汾、代、忻、朔、蔚、雲九州，治太原。

translations.literal: 723, eleventh year. The Tianbing Army circuit was redesignated the military commissioner of the various armies and prefectures north of Taiyuan Prefecture, supply and garrison-farm commissioner of the Hedong Circuit, and concurrently Northern Capital keeper, holding Taiyuan and the nine prefectures of Liao, Shi, Lan, Fen, Dai, Xin, Shuo, Wei, and Yun, with seat at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In 723, the eleventh year of Kaiyuan, the Tianbing Army command was redesignated the military commissioner of the armies and prefectures north of Taiyuan Prefecture, with concurrent posts as Hedong supply and garrison-farm commissioner and Northern Capital keeper, commanding Taiyuan plus Liao, Shi, Lan, Fen, Dai, Xin, Shuo, Wei, and Yun from his seat at Taiyuan.

translations.literal: 724, twelfth year.
translations.idiomatic: 724 CE, twelfth year.

translations.literal: 725, thirteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 725 CE, thirteenth year.

translations.literal: 726, fourteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 726 CE, fourteenth year.

translations.literal: 727, fifteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 727 CE, fifteenth year.

translations.literal: 728, sixteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 728 CE, sixteenth year.

sentences.zh: 729 十七年 以儀、石二州隸潞州都督。

translations.literal: 729, seventeenth year. Yi and Shi prefectures were placed under the Lu Prefecture area commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In 729, the seventeenth year of Kaiyuan, Yi and Shi prefectures were assigned to the Lu Prefecture area commandant.

sentences.zh: 730 十八年 更太原府以北諸軍州節度為河東節度。

translations.literal: 730, eighteenth year. The military commissioner of the various armies and prefectures north of Taiyuan Prefecture was redesignated the Hedong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 730, the eighteenth year of Kaiyuan, the command north of Taiyuan Prefecture was redesignated the Hedong circuit.

sentences.zh: 自後節度使領大同軍使，副使以代州刺史領之，復領儀、石二州。

translations.literal: Thereafter the military commissioner also held the post of Datong Army commissioner; the deputy commissioner was the prefect of Dai Prefecture, and Yi and Shi prefectures were again brought under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the military commissioner also commanded the Datong Army, with the deputy commissioner serving as prefect of Dai Prefecture, and Yi and Shi prefectures were restored to Hedong's command.

translations.idiomatic: 750 CE, ninth year.

sentences.zh: 756 至德元載 置河南節度使，治汴州，領郡十三：陳留、睢陽、靈昌、淮陽、汝陰、譙、濟陰、濮陽、淄川、琅邪、彭城、臨淮、東海。

translations.literal: 756, first year of the Zhide era. The Henan military commissioner was established, with seat at Bian Prefecture, holding thirteen commanderies: Chenliu, Suiyang, Lingchang, Huaiyang, Ruyin, Qiao, Jiyin, Puyang, Zichuan, Langya, Pengcheng, Linhuai, and Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: In 756, the first year of Zhide, a Henan military commissioner was created, headquartered at Bian Prefecture, commanding thirteen commanderies—Chenliu, Suiyang, Lingchang, Huaiyang, Ruyin, Qiao, Jiyin, Puyang, Zichuan, Langya, Pengcheng, Linhuai, and Donghai.

sentences.zh: 置淮南西道節度使，領義陽、弋陽、潁川、滎陽、汝南五郡，治潁川郡。

translations.literal: The Huainan West circuit military commissioner was established, holding Yiyang, Yiyang, Yingchuan, Xingyang, and Runan commanderies—five in all—with seat at Yingchuan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: A Huainan West circuit military commissioner was appointed, commanding five commanderies—Yiyang, Yiyang, Yingchuan, Xingyang, and Runan—from his seat at Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 置青密節度使，領北海、高密、東牟、東萊四郡，治北海郡。

translations.literal: The Qing-Mi military commissioner was established, holding Beihai, Gaomi, Dongmou, and Donglai commanderies—four in all—with seat at Beihai commandery.
translations.idiomatic: A Qing–Mi military commissioner was appointed, commanding four commanderies—Beihai, Gaomi, Dongmou, and Donglai—from his seat at Beihai.

sentences.zh: 置鄆、齊、兗三州都防禦使，治齊州。

translations.literal: A chief defense commissioner for Yun, Qi, and Yan prefectures was established, with seat at Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A chief defense commissioner for Yun, Qi, and Yan prefectures was installed, headquartered at Qi Prefecture.

translations.literal: 757, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 757 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 758 乾元元年 廢河南節度使，置汴州都防禦使，領州十三如故；

translations.literal: 758, first year of the Qianyuan era. The Henan military commissioner was abolished; a Bian Prefecture chief defense commissioner was established, holding the same thirteen prefectures as before;
translations.idiomatic: In 758, the first year of Qianyuan, the Henan military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a Bian Prefecture chief defense commissioner, still commanding the same thirteen prefectures;

sentences.zh: 尋以滑、濮二州隸青密節度，亳州隸淮西節度。

translations.literal: Before long, Hua and Pu prefectures were placed under the Qing-Mi circuit, and Bo Prefecture under the Huaixi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Hua and Pu were assigned to the Qing–Mi circuit, and Bo Prefecture to Huaixi.

sentences.zh: 淮南西道節度徙治鄭州，增領陳、潁、亳三州，別置豫許汝節度使，治豫州。

translations.literal: The Huainan West circuit military commissioner moved its seat to Zheng Prefecture, added Chen, Ying, and Bo prefectures to its jurisdiction, and a separate Yu-Xu-Ru military commissioner was established, with seat at Yu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan West circuit military commissioner moved his seat to Zheng Prefecture, gained Chen, Ying, and Bo, and a separate Yu–Xu–Ru military commissioner was installed at Yu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 青密節度增領滑、濮二州。

translations.literal: The Qing-Mi circuit added Hua and Pu prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing–Mi circuit gained jurisdiction over Hua and Pu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 759 二年 廢汴州都防禦使，置汴滑節度使，治滑州，領州五：滑、濮、汴、曹、宋。

translations.literal: 759, second year. The Bianzhou chief defense commissioner was abolished; the Bian-Hua military commissioner was established, with seat at Hua Prefecture, holding five prefectures: Hua, Pu, Bian, Cao, and Song.
translations.idiomatic: In 759, the second year of Zhide, the Bianzhou chief defense commissioner was abolished and replaced by a Bian–Hua military commissioner at Hua Prefecture, commanding Hua, Pu, Bian, Cao, and Song.

sentences.zh: 又置河南節度使，治徐州，領州五：徐、泗、海、亳、潁。

translations.literal: A Henan military commissioner was also established, with seat at Xu Prefecture, holding five prefectures: Xu, Si, Hai, Bo, and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Another Henan military commissioner was appointed, with his seat at Xu Prefecture, commanding Xu, Si, Hai, Bo, and Ying.

sentences.zh: 未幾，潁州隸鄭陳節度，尋復領潁州。

translations.literal: Before long, Ying Prefecture was placed under the Zheng-Chen circuit; soon Ying Prefecture was again brought under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Ying Prefecture was transferred to the Zheng–Chen circuit; soon it was restored to Henan's command.

sentences.zh: 是年，又以濮州隸兗鄆節度，潁、亳二州隸鄭陳節度。

translations.literal: In the same year, Pu Prefecture was also placed under the Yan-Yun circuit, and Ying and Bo prefectures under the Zheng-Chen circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Pu Prefecture was assigned to the Yan–Yun circuit, while Ying and Bo went to the Zheng–Chen circuit.

sentences.zh: 置鄭陳節度使，領鄭、陳、亳、潁四州，治鄭州，尋增領申、光、壽三州；

translations.literal: The Zheng-Chen military commissioner was established, holding Zheng, Chen, Bo, and Ying prefectures—four in all—with seat at Zheng Prefecture; soon Shen, Guang, and Shou prefectures were added to its jurisdiction;
translations.idiomatic: A Zheng–Chen military commissioner was created, commanding Zheng, Chen, Bo, and Ying from Zheng Prefecture; before long Shen, Guang, and Shou were added to his charge;

translations.literal: Before long, the three prefectures were placed under Huaixi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long those three prefectures were transferred to the Huaixi circuit.

sentences.zh: 廢淮南西道節度使，以陳、潁、亳隸陳鄭。

translations.literal: The Huainan West circuit military commissioner was abolished; Chen, Ying, and Bo prefectures were placed under Chen-Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan West circuit military commissioner was abolished, and Chen, Ying, and Bo were assigned to the Chen–Zheng circuit.

sentences.zh: 是年，復置淮南西道節度使，領申、光、壽、安、沔、蘄、黃七州，治壽州。

translations.literal: In the same year, the Huainan West circuit military commissioner was restored, holding Shen, Guang, Shou, An, Mian, Qi, and Huang prefectures—seven in all—with seat at Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Huainan West circuit military commissioner was reinstated, commanding seven prefectures—Shen, Guang, Shou, An, Mian, Qi, and Huang—from his seat at Shou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 青密節度使增領淄、沂、海三州。

translations.literal: The Qing-Mi military commissioner added Zi, Yi, and Hai prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing–Mi military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Zi, Yi, and Hai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 滑州隸汴滑節度使，濮州隸鄆齊兗節度使。

translations.literal: Hua Prefecture was placed under the Bian-Hua military commissioner; Pu Prefecture under the Yun-Qi-Yan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Prefecture was assigned to the Bian–Hua military commissioner, and Pu Prefecture to the Yun–Qi–Yan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是年以海州隸汴滑節度。

translations.literal: In the same year Hai Prefecture was placed under the Bian-Hua circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hai Prefecture was transferred to the Bian–Hua circuit.

sentences.zh: 升鄆、齊、兗三州都防禦使為節度使，治兗州，增領濮州，尋以濮州隸河南節度。

translations.literal: The chief defense commissioner for Yun, Qi, and Yan prefectures was promoted to military commissioner, with seat at Yan Prefecture; Pu Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction; soon Pu Prefecture was placed under the Henan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Yun–Qi–Yan chief defense commissioner was raised to military commissioner at Yan Prefecture and given Pu Prefecture; before long Pu was transferred to the Henan circuit.

sentences.zh: 760 上元元年 以海州隸青密節度。

translations.literal: 760, first year of the Shangyuan era. Hai Prefecture was placed under the Qing-Mi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 760, the first year of Shangyuan, Hai Prefecture was assigned to the Qing–Mi circuit.

translations.literal: Hai Prefecture was again placed under the Qing-Mi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Prefecture was restored to the Qing–Mi circuit.

sentences.zh: 761 二年 置滑衛節度使，治滑州，領州六：滑、衛、相、魏、德、貝。

translations.literal: 761, second year. The Hua-Wei military commissioner was established, with seat at Hua Prefecture, holding six prefectures: Hua, Wei, Xiang, Wei, De, and Bei.
translations.idiomatic: In 761, the second year of Shangyuan, a Hua–Wei military commissioner was created at Hua Prefecture, commanding Hua, Wei, Xiang, Wei, De, and Bei.

sentences.zh: 尋以德州隸淄沂節度而增領博州。

translations.literal: Soon De Prefecture was placed under the Zi-Yi circuit, and Bo Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Before long De Prefecture went to the Zi–Yi circuit while Bo Prefecture was added to Hua–Wei's command.

sentences.zh: 廢汴滑、河南二節度，以徐、泗、汴、宋、曹五州隸淮西節度，滑州隸滑衛節度。

translations.literal: The Bian-Hua and Henan circuits were abolished; Xu, Si, Bian, Song, and Cao prefectures—five in all—were placed under the Huaixi circuit, and Hua Prefecture under the Hua-Wei circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian–Hua and Henan circuits were abolished; Xu, Si, Bian, Song, and Cao were assigned to Huaixi, and Hua Prefecture to Hua–Wei.

sentences.zh: 廢鄭陳節度，以鄭、陳、亳、潁四州隸淮西。

translations.literal: The Zheng-Chen circuit was abolished; Zheng, Chen, Bo, and Ying prefectures were placed under Huaixi.
translations.idiomatic: The Zheng–Chen circuit was abolished, and Zheng, Chen, Bo, and Ying were transferred to Huaixi.

sentences.zh: 淮南西道節度使增領陳、鄭、潁、亳、汴、曹、宋、徐、泗九州，徙治安州，號淮西十六州節度使。

translations.literal: The Huainan West circuit military commissioner added Chen, Zheng, Ying, Bo, Bian, Cao, Song, Xu, and Si prefectures—nine in all—to its jurisdiction, moved its seat to An Prefecture, and was styled the Huaixi Sixteen Prefectures military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan West circuit military commissioner took command of nine more prefectures—Chen, Zheng, Ying, Bo, Bian, Cao, Song, Xu, and Si—moved his seat to An Prefecture, and was styled commissioner of the Huaixi Sixteen Prefectures circuit.

sentences.zh: 尋以亳州隸滑衛節度，徐州隸兗鄆節度。

translations.literal: Soon Bo Prefecture was placed under the Hua-Wei circuit, and Xu Prefecture under the Yan-Yun circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Bo Prefecture was assigned to Hua–Wei, and Xu Prefecture to Yan–Yun.

sentences.zh: 置淄沂節度使，領淄、沂、滄、德、棣五州，治沂州。

translations.literal: The Zi-Yi military commissioner was established, holding Zi, Yi, Cang, De, and Di prefectures—five in all—with seat at Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Zi–Yi military commissioner was appointed, commanding Zi, Yi, Cang, De, and Di from his seat at Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 平盧軍節度使侯希逸引兵保青州，授青密節度使，遂廢淄沂節度，並所管五州，號淄青平盧節度，增領齊州。

translations.literal: The Pinglu Army military commissioner Hou Xiy led troops to hold Qingzhou; he was appointed Qing-Mi military commissioner, whereupon the Zi-Yi circuit was abolished and its five prefectures were merged in, styled the Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit, and Qi Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Pinglu Army military commissioner Hou Xiy led his troops to hold Qingzhou and was appointed Qing–Mi military commissioner; the Zi–Yi circuit was then abolished and its five prefectures absorbed into the newly styled Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit, which also gained Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以齊州隸青密，而兗鄆節度增領徐州。

translations.literal: Qi Prefecture was placed under Qing-Mi, while the Yan-Yun circuit added Xu Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Prefecture was transferred to Qing–Mi, and the Yan–Yun circuit gained Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 762 寶應元年 復置河南節度使，治汴州，領州八：汴、宋、曹、徐、潁、兗、鄆、濮。

translations.literal: 762, first year of the Baoying era. The Henan military commissioner was restored, with seat at Bian Prefecture, holding eight prefectures: Bian, Song, Cao, Xu, Ying, Yan, Yun, and Pu.
translations.idiomatic: In 762, the first year of Baoying, the Henan military commissioner was reinstated, headquartered at Bian Prefecture, commanding Bian, Song, Cao, Xu, Ying, Yan, Yun, and Pu.

sentences.zh: 淮西節度增領許、隋、唐三州，以鄭州隸澤潞節度，潁、汴、宋、曹四州隸河南節度，泗州隸兗鄆節度，申州隸蔡汝節度。

translations.literal: The Huaixi circuit added Xu, Sui, and Tang prefectures to its jurisdiction; Zheng Prefecture was placed under the Ze-Lu circuit; Ying, Bian, Song, and Cao prefectures under the Henan circuit; Si Prefecture under the Yan-Yun circuit; and Shen Prefecture under the Cai-Ru circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Huaixi gained Xu, Sui, and Tang prefectures; Zheng went to the Ze–Lu circuit, Ying, Bian, Song, and Cao to Henan, Si to Yan–Yun, and Shen to Cai–Ru.

sentences.zh: 登、萊、沂、海、泗五州隸兗鄆節度。

translations.literal: Deng, Lai, Yi, Hai, and Si prefectures—five in all—were placed under the Yan-Yun circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Deng, Lai, Yi, Hai, and Si were assigned to the Yan–Yun circuit.

sentences.zh: 是年，廢兗鄆節度，以鄆、兗、濮、徐四州隸河南節度，登、萊、沂、海、泗隸淄青平盧節度。

translations.literal: In the same year, the Yan-Yun circuit was abolished; Yun, Yan, Pu, and Xu prefectures were placed under the Henan circuit, and Deng, Lai, Yi, Hai, and Si under the Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Yan–Yun circuit was abolished; Yun, Yan, Pu, and Xu went to Henan, and Deng, Lai, Yi, Hai, and Si to the Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit.

sentences.zh: 763 廣德元年 滑衛節度增領亳州，更號滑亳節度使，增領德州。

translations.literal: 763, first year of the Guangde era. The Hua-Wei circuit added Bo Prefecture to its jurisdiction, was redesignated the Hua-Bo military commissioner, and added De Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 763, the first year of Guangde, the Hua–Wei circuit gained Bo Prefecture, was redesignated the Hua–Bo military commissioner, and also gained De Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以衛州隸澤潞，析相、貝別置節度，魏博別置防禦。

translations.literal: Wei Prefecture was placed under Ze-Lu; Xiang and Bei were separated out and given their own military commissioner, and Weibo was given a separate chief defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Prefecture was assigned to Ze–Lu; Xiang and Bei were split off under a new military commissioner, and Weibo received a separate chief defense commissioner.

translations.literal: Cang and De prefectures were placed under the Weibo circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Cang and De prefectures were assigned to the Weibo circuit.

sentences.zh: 淄青平盧節度增領瀛州；

translations.literal: The Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit added Ying Prefecture to its jurisdiction;
translations.idiomatic: The Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit gained Ying Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 未幾，瀛州復隸魏博節度。

translations.literal: Before long, Ying Prefecture was again placed under the Weibo circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Ying Prefecture was transferred back to the Weibo circuit.

translations.literal: 764, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 764 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 765 永泰元年 沔、蘄、黃三州隸鄂岳節度。

translations.literal: 765, first year of the Yongtai era. Mian, Qi, and Huang prefectures were placed under the E-Yue circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 765, the first year of Yongtai, Mian, Qi, and Huang prefectures were assigned to the E–Yue circuit.

sentences.zh: 淄青平盧節度增領押新羅渤海兩蕃使。

translations.literal: The Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit added the post of commissioner for subjugating Silla, Bohai, and the two tribal peoples to its duties.
translations.idiomatic: The Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit also took on the post of commissioner for subjugating Silla, Bohai, and the two tribal peoples.

translations.literal: 766, first year of the Dali era.
translations.idiomatic: 766 CE, first year of the Dali reign.

translations.literal: 767, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 767 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 768 三年 蔡汝節度增領仙州。

translations.literal: 768, third year. The Cai-Ru circuit added Xian Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 768, the third year of Dali, the Cai–Ru circuit gained Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 769 四年 滑亳節度增領陳州。

translations.literal: 769, fourth year. The Hua-Bo circuit added Chen Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 769, the fourth year of Dali, the Hua–Bo circuit gained Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河南節度增領泗州，以潁州隸澤潞節度。

translations.literal: The Henan circuit added Si Prefecture to its jurisdiction, and Ying Prefecture was placed under the Ze-Lu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Henan gained Si Prefecture, while Ying Prefecture was assigned to the Ze–Lu circuit.

sentences.zh: 淄青平盧節度罷領海、沂、密三州，置海、沂、密三州都防禦使，尋廢，復以三州隸淄青平盧節度。

translations.literal: The Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit ceased holding Hai, Yi, and Mi prefectures; a chief defense commissioner for Hai, Yi, and Mi prefectures was established; soon it was abolished, and the three prefectures were again placed under the Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit relinquished Hai, Yi, and Mi; a chief defense commissioner for those three prefectures was installed, then abolished, and the three prefectures were restored to Zi–Qing–Pinglu.

translations.literal: 770, fifth year. Xian Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 770, the fifth year of Dali, Xian Prefecture was abolished.

translations.literal: 771, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 771 CE, sixth year.

sentences.zh: 772 七年 賜滑亳節度為永平節度。

translations.literal: 772, seventh year. The Hua-Bo circuit was granted the title Yongping circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 772, the seventh year of Dali, the Hua–Bo circuit was granted the title Yongping circuit.

sentences.zh: 773 八年 淮西節度使徙治蔡州，廢蔡汝節度使，所管州皆隸淮西節度。

translations.literal: 773, eighth year. The Huaixi military commissioner moved its seat to Cai Prefecture; the Cai-Ru military commissioner was abolished, and all prefectures under its command were placed under the Huaixi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 773, the eighth year of Dali, the Huaixi military commissioner moved his seat to Cai Prefecture; the Cai–Ru military commissioner was abolished and all his prefectures transferred to Huaixi.

translations.literal: 774, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 774 CE, ninth year.

sentences.zh: 775 十年 淄青平盧節度又領德州。

translations.literal: 775, tenth year. The Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit again took De Prefecture under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 775, the tenth year of Dali, the Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit again gained De Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 776 十一年 永平節度增領宋、泗二州。

translations.literal: 776, eleventh year. The Yongping circuit added Song and Si prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 776, the eleventh year of Dali, the Yongping circuit gained jurisdiction over Song and Si prefectures.

sentences.zh: 廢河南節度使，曹、兗、鄆、濮、徐五州隸淄青節度，宋、潁、泗三州隸永平軍節度，汴州隸淮西節度。

translations.literal: The Henan military commissioner was abolished; Cao, Yan, Yun, Pu, and Xu prefectures—five in all—were placed under the Zi-Qing circuit, Song, Ying, and Si under the Yongping Army circuit, and Bian Prefecture under the Huaixi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan military commissioner was abolished; Cao, Yan, Yun, Pu, and Xu went to the Zi–Qing circuit, Song, Ying, and Si to the Yongping Army circuit, and Bian Prefecture to Huaixi.

sentences.zh: 淮西節度使增領汴州，徙治汴州。

translations.literal: The Huaixi military commissioner added Bian Prefecture to its jurisdiction and moved its seat to Bian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Huaixi military commissioner took Bian Prefecture under his command and moved his seat there.

sentences.zh: 淄青平盧節度增領鄆、曹、濮、徐、兗五州，以泗州隸永平軍節度。

translations.literal: The Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit added Yun, Cao, Pu, Xu, and Yan prefectures—five in all—to its jurisdiction; Si Prefecture was placed under the Yongping Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit gained Yun, Cao, Pu, Xu, and Yan, while Si Prefecture was assigned to the Yongping Army circuit.

translations.literal: 777, twelfth year.
translations.idiomatic: 777 CE, twelfth year.

translations.literal: 778, thirteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 778 CE, thirteenth year.

sentences.zh: 779 十四年 永平節度增領汴、潁二州，徙治汴州。

translations.literal: 779, fourteenth year. The Yongping circuit added Bian and Ying prefectures to its jurisdiction and moved its seat to Bian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 779, the fourteenth year of Dali, the Yongping circuit gained Bian and Ying and moved its seat to Bian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 淮西節度使復治蔡州，是年賜號淮寧軍節度，尋更號申光蔡節度使，汝州隸東都畿，汴州隸永平軍節度。

translations.literal: The Huaixi military commissioner again administered from Cai Prefecture; in the same year it was granted the title Huaining Army circuit, and soon redesignated the Shen-Guang-Cai military commissioner; Ru Prefecture was placed under the Eastern Capital Intendant, and Bian Prefecture under the Yongping Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Huaixi military commissioner again made Cai his seat; that year the command was granted the title Huaining Army circuit, then redesignated the Shen–Guang–Cai military commissioner; Ru Prefecture went to the Eastern Capital Intendant, and Bian Prefecture to the Yongping Army circuit.

translations.literal: 780, first year of the Jianzhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 780 CE, first year of the Jianzhong reign.

sentences.zh: 781 二年 永平節度增領鄭州，析宋、亳、潁別置節度使，以泗州隸淮南。

translations.literal: 781, second year. The Yongping circuit added Zheng Prefecture to its jurisdiction; Song, Bo, and Ying were separated out and given their own military commissioner, and Si Prefecture was placed under Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In 781, the second year of Jianzhong, Yongping gained Zheng Prefecture; Song, Bo, and Ying were split off under a new military commissioner, and Si Prefecture was assigned to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 是年以鄭州隸河陽三城節度，既而復舊。

translations.literal: In the same year Zheng Prefecture was placed under the Heyang Three Fortresses circuit; before long the former arrangement was restored.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Zheng Prefecture was transferred to the Heyang Three Fortresses circuit, but the former arrangement was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 置宋亳潁節度使，治宋州，尋號宣武軍節度使。

translations.literal: A Song-Bo-Ying military commissioner was established, with seat at Song Prefecture; soon it was styled the Xuanwu Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: A Song–Bo–Ying military commissioner was installed at Song Prefecture; before long the post was styled the Xuanwu Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 782 三年 置徐海沂密都團練觀察使，治徐州。

translations.literal: 782, third year. A Xu-Hai-Yi-Mi regimental training observation commissioner was established, with seat at Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 782, the third year of Jianzhong, a Xu–Hai–Yi–Mi regimental training observation commissioner was installed, headquartered at Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廢淄青平盧節度使，置淄青都團練觀察使，領淄、青、登、萊、齊、兗、鄆七州，治青州；

translations.literal: The Zi-Qing-Pinglu military commissioner was abolished; a Zi-Qing regimental training observation commissioner was established, holding Zi, Qing, Deng, Lai, Qi, Yan, and Yun prefectures—seven in all—with seat at Qing Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: The Zi–Qing–Pinglu military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a Zi–Qing regimental training observation commissioner commanding Zi, Qing, Deng, Lai, Qi, Yan, and Yun from Qing Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 置曹濮都團練觀察使，治濮州。

translations.literal: A Cao-Pu regimental training observation commissioner was established, with seat at Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Cao–Pu regimental training observation commissioner was installed, headquartered at Pu Prefecture.

translations.literal: 783, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 783 CE, fourth year.

sentences.zh: 784 興元元年 永平軍節度以汴、滑二州隸宣武軍，尋復領滑州，徙治滑州。

translations.literal: 784, first year of the Xingyuan era. The Yongping Army circuit placed Bian and Hua prefectures under the Xuanwu Army; before long it again took Hua Prefecture under its jurisdiction and moved its seat to Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 784, the first year of Xingyuan, the Yongping Army circuit transferred Bian and Hua to the Xuanwu Army; before long it regained Hua Prefecture and moved its seat there.

sentences.zh: 宣武軍節度使徒治汴州。

translations.literal: The Xuanwu Army military commissioner moved its seat to Bian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanwu Army military commissioner moved his seat to Bian Prefecture.

translations.literal: A separate observation commissioner was established for Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A separate observation commissioner was installed for Shou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廢徐海沂密都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The Xu-Hai-Yi-Mi regimental training observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Xu–Hai–Yi–Mi regimental training observation commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 復置淄青平盧節度使，領青、淄、登、萊、齊、兗、鄆、徐、海、沂、密、曹、濮十三州，治青州，廢曹濮都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The Zi-Qing-Pinglu military commissioner was restored, holding Qing, Zi, Deng, Lai, Qi, Yan, Yun, Xu, Hai, Yi, Mi, Cao, and Pu prefectures—thirteen in all—with seat at Qing Prefecture; the Cao-Pu regimental training observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Zi–Qing–Pinglu military commissioner was reinstated, commanding thirteen prefectures—Qing, Zi, Deng, Lai, Qi, Yan, Yun, Xu, Hai, Yi, Mi, Cao, and Pu—from Qing Prefecture, and the Cao–Pu regimental training observation commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 賜河東節度號保寧軍節度。

translations.literal: The Hedong circuit was granted the title Baoning Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hedong circuit was granted the title Baoning Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 785 貞元元年 永平軍節度更號義成軍節度，增領許州。

translations.literal: 785, first year of the Zhenyuan era. The Yongping Army circuit was renamed the Yicheng Army circuit and added Xu Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 785, the first year of Zhenyuan, the Yongping Army circuit was redesignated the Yicheng Army circuit and gained jurisdiction over Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 唐州隸東都畿，許州隸義成軍節度。

translations.literal: Tang Prefecture was placed under the Eastern Capital Intendant; Xu Prefecture under the Yicheng Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Prefecture was assigned to the Eastern Capital Intendant, and Xu Prefecture to the Yicheng Army circuit.

translations.literal: 786, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 786 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 787 三年 以許州隸陳許節度使。

translations.literal: 787, third year. Xu Prefecture was placed under the Chen-Xu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 787, the third year of Zhenyuan, Xu Prefecture was assigned to the Chen–Xu military commissioner.

translations.literal: A Chen-Xu military commissioner was established, with seat at Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Chen–Xu military commissioner was installed, headquartered at Xu Prefecture.

translations.literal: An Prefecture was placed under the Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: An Prefecture was assigned to the Shannan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 保寧軍節度復為河東節度。

translations.literal: The Baoning Army circuit was again made the Hedong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Baoning Army circuit reverted to the Hedong circuit.

sentences.zh: 788 四年 置徐、泗、濠三州節度使，治徐州。

translations.literal: 788, fourth year. A military commissioner for Xu, Si, and Hao prefectures was established, with seat at Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 788, the fourth year of Zhenyuan, a military commissioner for Xu, Si, and Hao was installed, headquartered at Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 淄青平盧節度使徙治鄆州，以徐州隸徐泗節度。

translations.literal: The Zi-Qing-Pinglu military commissioner moved its seat to Yun Prefecture, and Xu Prefecture was placed under the Xu-Si circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zi–Qing–Pinglu military commissioner moved his seat to Yun Prefecture, and Xu Prefecture was assigned to the Xu–Si circuit.

translations.literal: 789, fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: 789 CE, fifth year.

translations.literal: 790, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 790 CE, sixth year.

translations.literal: 791, seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 791 CE, seventh year.

translations.literal: 792, eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: 792 CE, eighth year.

translations.literal: 793, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 793 CE, ninth year.

sentences.zh: 794 十年 陳許節度賜號忠武軍節度。

translations.literal: 794, tenth year. The Chen-Xu circuit was granted the title Zhongwu Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 794, the tenth year of Zhenyuan, the Chen–Xu circuit was granted the title Zhongwu Army circuit.

translations.literal: 795, eleventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 795 CE, eleventh year.

translations.literal: 796, twelfth year.
translations.idiomatic: 796 CE, twelfth year.

translations.literal: 797, thirteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 797 CE, thirteenth year.

sentences.zh: 798 十四年 申光蔡節度賜號彰義軍節度。

translations.literal: 798, fourteenth year. The Shen-Guang-Cai circuit was granted the title Zhangyi Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 798, the fourteenth year of Zhenyuan, the Shen–Guang–Cai circuit was granted the title Zhangyi Army circuit.

translations.literal: 799, fifteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 799 CE, fifteenth year.

sentences.zh: 800 十六年 廢徐、泗、濠三州節度使，未幾，復置泗、濠二州觀察使，隸淮南。

translations.literal: 800, sixteenth year. The military commissioner for Xu, Si, and Hao prefectures was abolished; before long observation commissioners for Si and Hao prefectures were restored, placed under Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In 800, the sixteenth year of Zhenyuan, the Xu–Si–Hao military commissioner was abolished; before long observation commissioners for Si and Hao were reinstated under Huainan.

translations.literal: Xu Prefecture held a regent commissioner for its own prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Prefecture was administered by a local regent commissioner.

translations.literal: 801 CE, seventeenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 801 CE, seventeenth year.

translations.literal: 802 CE, eighteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 802 CE, eighteenth year.

translations.literal: 803 CE, nineteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 803 CE, nineteenth year.

translations.literal: 804 CE, twentieth year.
translations.idiomatic: 804 CE, twentieth year.

translations.literal: 805, first year of the Yongzhen era.
translations.idiomatic: 805 CE, first year of the Yongzhen reign.

translations.literal: 806, first year of the Yuanhe era.
translations.idiomatic: 806 CE, first year of the Yuanhe reign.

sentences.zh: 807 二年 廢泗、濠二州觀察使，置武寧軍節度使，治徐州，領徐、泗、濠三州。

translations.literal: 807, second year. The observation commissioners for Si and Hao prefectures were abolished; a Wuning Army military commissioner was established, with seat at Xu Prefecture, holding Xu, Si, and Hao prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In 807, the second year of Yuanhe, the Si and Hao observation commissioners were abolished and replaced by a Wuning Army military commissioner at Xu Prefecture, commanding Xu, Si, and Hao.

translations.literal: 808, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 808 CE, third year.

sentences.zh: 809 四年 武寧軍節度增領宿州。

translations.literal: 809, fourth year. The Wuning Army circuit added Su Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 809, the fourth year of Yuanhe, the Wuning Army circuit gained Su Prefecture.

translations.literal: 810, fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: 810 CE, fifth year.

translations.literal: 811, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 811 CE, sixth year.

translations.literal: 812, seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 812 CE, seventh year.

translations.literal: 813, eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: 813 CE, eighth year.

translations.literal: 814, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 814 CE, ninth year.

translations.literal: 815, tenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 815 CE, tenth year.

sentences.zh: 816 十一年 彰義軍節度增領唐、隋、鄧三州，尋以三州別置節度使。

translations.literal: 816, eleventh year. The Zhangyi Army circuit added Tang, Sui, and Deng prefectures to its jurisdiction; before long the three prefectures were separated out and given their own military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 816, the eleventh year of Yuanhe, the Zhangyi Army circuit gained Tang, Sui, and Deng; before long those three prefectures were split off under a new military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 817 十二年 忠武節度增領溵州。

translations.literal: 817, twelfth year. The Zhongwu circuit added Yin Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 817, the twelfth year of Yuanhe, the Zhongwu circuit gained Yin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 彰義軍節度復為淮西節度，增領溵州，未幾，以溵州隸忠武軍節度。

translations.literal: The Zhangyi Army circuit was again made the Huaixi circuit and added Yin Prefecture to its jurisdiction; before long Yin Prefecture was placed under the Zhongwu Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhangyi Army circuit reverted to Huaixi and gained Yin Prefecture; before long Yin Prefecture was assigned to the Zhongwu Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 818 十三年 忠武軍節度增領蔡州。

translations.literal: 818, thirteenth year. The Zhongwu Army circuit added Cai Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 818, the thirteenth year of Yuanhe, the Zhongwu Army circuit gained Cai Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Huaixi circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Huaixi circuit was abolished.

sentences.zh: 819 十四年 淄青平盧節度使領青、淄、齊、登、萊五州，復治青州。

translations.literal: 819, fourteenth year. The Zi-Qing-Pinglu military commissioner held Qing, Zi, Qi, Deng, and Lai prefectures—five in all—and again administered from Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 819, the fourteenth year of Yuanhe, the Zi–Qing–Pinglu military commissioner commanded Qing, Zi, Qi, Deng, and Lai and again made Qing his seat.

sentences.zh: 置鄆曹濮節度使，治鄆州。

translations.literal: A Yun-Cao-Pu military commissioner was established, with seat at Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Yun–Cao–Pu military commissioner was installed, headquartered at Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置沂海觀察使，領沂、海、兗、密四州，治沂州。

translations.literal: A Yi-Hai observation commissioner was established, holding Yi, Hai, Yan, and Mi prefectures—four in all—with seat at Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Yi–Hai observation commissioner was installed, commanding Yi, Hai, Yan, and Mi from his seat at Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 820 十五年 賜鄆曹濮節度使號天平軍節度使。

translations.literal: 820, fifteenth year. The Yun-Cao-Pu military commissioner was granted the title Tianping Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 820, the fifteenth year of Yuanhe, the Yun–Cao–Pu military commissioner was granted the title Tianping Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 821 長慶元年 宿州隸淮南節度。

translations.literal: 821, first year of the Changqing era. Su Prefecture was placed under the Huainan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 821, the first year of Changqing, Su Prefecture was assigned to the Huainan circuit.

sentences.zh: 升沂海觀察使為節度使，徙治兗州。

translations.literal: The Yi-Hai observation commissioner was promoted to military commissioner, and its seat was moved to Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi–Hai observation commissioner was raised to military commissioner, and his seat was moved to Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河東節度使領押北山諸蕃使。

translations.literal: The Hedong military commissioner also held the post of commissioner for subjugating the various tribal peoples of the Northern Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The Hedong military commissioner also served as commissioner in charge of the Northern Mountain tribes.

sentences.zh: 822 二年 義成軍節度使復領潁州。

translations.literal: 822, second year. The Yicheng Army military commissioner again took Ying Prefecture under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 822, the second year of Changqing, the Yicheng Army military commissioner regained jurisdiction over Ying Prefecture.

translations.literal: Yin Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Prefecture was abolished.

translations.literal: 823, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 823 CE, third year.

translations.literal: 824, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 824 CE, fourth year.

translations.literal: 825, first year of the Baoli era.
translations.idiomatic: 825 CE, first year of the Baoli reign.

translations.literal: 826, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 826 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 827 大和元年 齊州隸橫海節度。

translations.literal: 827, first year of the Dahe era. Qi Prefecture was placed under the Henghai circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 827, the first year of Dahe, Qi Prefecture was assigned to the Henghai circuit.

sentences.zh: 828 二年 淄青平盧節度增領棣州。

translations.literal: 828, second year. The Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit added Di Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 828, the second year of Dahe, the Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit gained Di Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: 829 CE, third year.

translations.idiomatic: 830 CE, fourth year.

translations.idiomatic: 831 CE, fifth year.

translations.literal: 832, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 832 CE, sixth year.

sentences.zh: 833 七年 宿州復隸武寧節度。

translations.literal: 833, seventh year. Su Prefecture was again placed under the Wuning circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 833, the seventh year of Dahe, Su Prefecture was restored to the Wuning circuit.

sentences.zh: 834 八年 廢沂海節度使為觀察使。

translations.literal: 834, eighth year. The Yi-Hai military commissioner was abolished and made an observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 834, the eighth year of Dahe, the Yi–Hai military commissioner was reduced to an observation commissioner.

translations.literal: 835, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 835 CE, ninth year.

translations.literal: 836, first year of the Kaicheng era.
translations.idiomatic: 836 CE, first year of the Kaicheng reign.

translations.idiomatic: 837 CE, second year.

translations.literal: 838, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 838 CE, third year.

translations.literal: 839, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 839 CE, fourth year.

translations.literal: 841, first year of the Huichang era.
translations.idiomatic: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign.

translations.literal: 842, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 842 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 843 三年 河東節度使罷領雲、朔、蔚三州，以雲、蔚、朔三州置大同都團練使，治雲州。

translations.literal: 843, third year. The Hedong military commissioner ceased holding Yun, Shuo, and Wei prefectures; a Datong regimental training commissioner was established for Yun, Wei, and Shuo prefectures, with seat at Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 843, the third year of Huichang, the Hedong military commissioner relinquished Yun, Shuo, and Wei; a Datong regimental training commissioner was installed for Yun, Wei, and Shuo, headquartered at Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 844 四年 升大同都團練使為大同都防禦使。

translations.literal: 844, fourth year. The Datong regimental training commissioner was promoted to Datong chief defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 844, the fourth year of Huichang, the Datong regimental training commissioner was raised to Datong chief defense commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: 847 CE, first year of the Dazhong reign.

sentences.zh: 848 二年 置蔡州防禦使、龍陂監牧使。

translations.literal: 848, second year. A Cai Prefecture chief defense commissioner and a Longpo pasture supervisor were established.
translations.idiomatic: In 848, the second year of Dazhong, a Cai Prefecture chief defense commissioner and a Longpo pasture supervisor were installed.

sentences.zh: 851 五年 升沂海觀察使為節度使。

translations.literal: 851, fifth year. The Yi-Hai observation commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 851, the fifth year of Dazhong, the Yi–Hai observation commissioner was raised to military commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: 861 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 862 三年 罷武寧軍節度。

translations.literal: 862, third year. The Wuning Army circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 862, the third year of Xiantong, the Wuning Army circuit was abolished.

sentences.zh: 置徐州團練防禦使，隸兗海。

translations.literal: A Xu Prefecture regimental training chief defense commissioner was established, placed under Yan-Hai.
translations.idiomatic: A Xu Prefecture regimental training chief defense commissioner was installed, subordinate to Yan–Hai.

sentences.zh: 又置宿、泗等州都團練觀察處置使，治宿州。

translations.literal: A regimental training observation disposition commissioner for Su, Si, and other prefectures was also established, with seat at Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A regimental training observation disposition commissioner for Su, Si, and other prefectures was also installed, headquartered at Su Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Yi-Hai military commissioner added Xu Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi–Hai military commissioner gained Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 863 四年 罷徐州防禦使，以濠州隸淮南節度。

translations.literal: 863, fourth year. The Xu Prefecture chief defense commissioner was abolished, and Hao Prefecture was placed under the Huainan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 863, the fourth year of Xiantong, the Xu Prefecture chief defense commissioner was abolished, and Hao Prefecture was assigned to the Huainan circuit.

sentences.zh: 864 五年 置徐泗團練觀察處置使，治徐州。

translations.literal: 864, fifth year. A Xu-Si regimental training observation disposition commissioner was established, with seat at Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 864, the fifth year of Xiantong, a Xu–Si regimental training observation disposition commissioner was installed, headquartered at Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 天平軍節度增領齊、棣二州。

translations.literal: The Tianping Army circuit added Qi and Di prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianping Army circuit gained Qi and Di prefectures.

translations.literal: The Yi-Hai military commissioner ceased holding Xu Prefecture under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi–Hai military commissioner relinquished jurisdiction over Xu Prefecture.

translations.literal: 865, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 865 CE, sixth year.

translations.idiomatic: 866 CE, seventh year.

translations.idiomatic: 867 CE, eighth year.

translations.literal: 868, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 868 CE, ninth year.

sentences.zh: 869 十年 置徐泗節度使。

translations.literal: 869, tenth year. A Xu-Si military commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 869, the tenth year of Xiantong, a Xu–Si military commissioner was installed.

sentences.zh: 是年，復置都團練防禦使，增領濠、宿二州。

translations.literal: In the same year, a regimental training chief defense commissioner was restored, and Hao and Su prefectures were added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: That same year a regimental training chief defense commissioner was reinstated, with Hao and Su added to his command.

sentences.zh: 870 十一年 置徐泗觀察使，尋賜號感化軍節度使。

translations.literal: 870, eleventh year. A Xu-Si observation commissioner was established; soon it was granted the title Ganhuo Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 870, the eleventh year of Xiantong, a Xu–Si observation commissioner was installed; before long the post was granted the title Ganhuo Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: 871, twelfth year.
translations.idiomatic: 871 CE, twelfth year.

sentences.zh: 872 十三年 淄青平盧節度復領齊、棣二州。

translations.literal: 872, thirteenth year. The Zi-Qing-Pinglu circuit again took Qi and Di prefectures under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 872, the thirteenth year of Xiantong, the Zi–Qing–Pinglu circuit regained Qi and Di prefectures.

translations.literal: 873, fourteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 873 CE, fourteenth year.

translations.literal: 874, first year of the Qianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 874 CE, first year of the Qianfu reign.

sentences.zh: 875 二年 感化軍節度罷領泗州。

translations.literal: 875, second year. The Ganhuo Army circuit ceased holding Si Prefecture under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 875, the second year of Qianfu, the Ganhuo Army circuit relinquished Si Prefecture.

translations.literal: 876, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 876 CE, third year.

translations.literal: 877, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 877 CE, fourth year.

sentences.zh: 878 五年 升大同都防禦使為節度使。

translations.literal: 878, fifth year. The Datong chief defense commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 878, the fifth year of Qianfu, the Datong chief defense commissioner was raised to military commissioner.

translations.literal: 879, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 879 CE, sixth year.

translations.literal: 880, first year of the Guangming era.
translations.idiomatic: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign.

translations.literal: 881, first year of the Zhonghe era.
translations.idiomatic: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign.

sentences.zh: 882 二年 蔡州置奉國軍節度。

translations.literal: 882, second year. The Fengguo Army circuit was established at Cai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 882, the second year of Zhonghe, the Fengguo Army circuit was established at Cai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升蔡州防禦使為奉國軍節度。

translations.literal: The Cai Prefecture chief defense commissioner was promoted to the Fengguo Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Cai Prefecture chief defense commissioner was raised to the Fengguo Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 河東節度增領麟州，以忻、代二州隸鴈門節度。

translations.literal: The Hedong circuit added Lin Prefecture to its jurisdiction, and Xin and Dai prefectures were placed under the Yanmen circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong gained Lin Prefecture, while Xin and Dai were assigned to the Yanmen circuit.

sentences.zh: 更大同節度為鴈門節度，領左神策軍、天寧鎮遏觀察使，徙治代州。

translations.literal: The Datong circuit was further redesignated the Yanmen circuit, also holding the Left Divine Strategy Army and the Tianning suppression observation commissioner, and moved its seat to Dai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Datong circuit was further redesignated the Yanmen circuit, also commanding the Left Divine Strategy Army and the Tianning suppression observation commissioner, and moved its seat to Dai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 883 三年 賜鴈門節度為代北節度。

translations.literal: 883, third year. The Yanmen circuit was granted the title Northern Dai circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 883, the third year of Zhonghe, the Yanmen circuit was granted the title Northern Dai circuit.

sentences.zh: 884 四年 河東節度復領雲、蔚二州。

translations.literal: 884, fourth year. The Hedong circuit again took Yun and Wei prefectures under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 884, the fourth year of Zhonghe, the Hedong circuit regained Yun and Wei prefectures.

translations.literal: 885, first year of the Guangqi era.
translations.idiomatic: 885 CE, first year of the Guangqi reign.

sentences.zh: 886 二年 義成軍節度使改為宣義軍節度使，朱全忠請改，以避其父名。

translations.literal: 886, second year. The Yicheng Army military commissioner was changed to the Xuanyi Army military commissioner; Zhu Quanzhong requested the change to avoid his father's name.
translations.idiomatic: In 886, the second year of Guangqi, the Yicheng Army military commissioner was redesignated the Xuanyi Army military commissioner at Zhu Quanzhong's request, to avoid his father's name.

translations.literal: 887, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 887 CE, third year.

translations.literal: 888, first year of the Wende era.
translations.idiomatic: 888 CE, first year of the Wende reign.

sentences.zh: 889 龍紀元年 河東節度增領憲州。

translations.literal: 889, first year of the Longji era. The Hedong circuit added Xian Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 889, the first year of Longji, the Hedong circuit gained jurisdiction over Xian Prefecture.

translations.literal: 890, first year of the Dashun era.
translations.idiomatic: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign.

sentences.zh: 894 乾寧元年 忠武軍節度增領汝州。

translations.literal: 894, first year of the Qianning era. The Zhongwu Army circuit added Ru Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 894, the first year of Qianning, the Zhongwu Army circuit gained jurisdiction over Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 895 二年 析齊州置武肅軍防禦使。

translations.literal: 895, second year. Qi Prefecture was split off and a Wusu Army chief defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 895, the second year of Qianning, Qi Prefecture was split off under a Wusu Army chief defense commissioner.

translations.literal: 896, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 896 CE, third year.

sentences.zh: 897 四年 奉國軍節度增領申、和二州。

translations.literal: 897, fourth year. The Fengguo Army circuit added Shen and He prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 897, the fourth year of Qianning, the Fengguo Army circuit gained Shen and He prefectures.

sentences.zh: 賜沂海節度使為泰寧軍節度使。

translations.literal: The Yi-Hai military commissioner was granted the title Taining Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi–Hai military commissioner was granted the title Taining Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 898 光化元年 感化軍節度復為武寧軍節度，未幾，復為感化軍節度。

translations.literal: 898, first year of the Guanghua era. The Ganhuo Army circuit was again made the Wuning Army circuit; before long, it was again made the Ganhuo Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 898, the first year of Guanghua, the Ganhuo Army circuit was redesignated the Wuning Army circuit; before long it reverted to the Ganhuo Army circuit.

translations.literal: 899, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 899 CE, second year.

translations.literal: 900, third year. Ru Prefecture was placed under the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In 900, the third year of Tianfu, Ru Prefecture was assigned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 901 天復元年 罷武肅軍防禦使。

translations.literal: 901, first year of the Tianfu era. The Wusu Army chief defense commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 901, the first year of Tianfu, the Wusu Army chief defense commissioner was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 902 二年 罷感化軍節度。

translations.literal: 902, second year. The Ganhuo Army circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 902, the second year of Tianfu, the Ganhuo Army circuit was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: 903 CE, third year.

translations.idiomatic: 904 CE, first year of the Tianyou reign.
